$comment: 语法大厅 G18（V0.9 P2a 骨架层）。比喻锚点：beautifuler 念不出来 → 语言是懒的。与 KET 八课 L8 共用说法（L8 原文：短词加 -er，长词前面放 more；你念念 beautifuler——念不出来吧？语言是懒的，怎么顺口怎么来；比一比要有 than；最高级前面要 the），L8 零改动。暗线主打课：good/better/best、bad/worse/worst 恰是最高频形容词——越常用的词，越不规则，与 L8 hiddenLineNote 同口径。全部内容原创。
title: 比较级与最高级
metaphor: beautifuler 念不出来 → 语言是懒的
ketNote: 比较级是 KET Part 5 的常客，good/better/best 这几个不规则变化更是重点盯防对象。八课里的亲戚是 L8。

sections.essence: 短词加 -er，长词请 more；语言是懒的，怎么顺口怎么来。
sections.why: 中文比东西，形容词纹丝不动，前面摆个「更」或「最」就完事：更高、最高。英语却让形容词自己变形：tall→taller→tallest。可为什么 beautiful 不变成 beautifuler？你念念看——舌头直接打结。这就是英语的分工逻辑：语言是懒的，怎么顺口怎么来。短词加个尾巴不费劲，就加 -er/-est；长词加了尾巴念不动，就请 more/most 站在前面帮忙。而用得最狠的那几个词——good、bad——连尾巴都懒得加，直接换一张脸：better/best、worse/worst。KET Part 5 年年在这儿设题：短词长词分工、than 和 the 的到场、还有那几张「换脸」的不规则面孔，全是送分点，也全是丢分点。
sections.metaphorStory: 银帆乐队要做新演出服，裁缝挨个量身高。卷尺一拉：Tom is taller than Ben.——比一比，tall 尾巴上长出 -er，后面还得跟个 than，不然不知道跟谁比。量到最后，裁缝宣布：Amy is the tallest in the band.——全团范围里的第一名，头上要戴 the 这顶冠冕，身后要报出范围 in the band。选演出服那天起了争论：这条裙子和那条哪个更好看？造型师说 This one is more beautiful.——鼓手小北不服气：「为什么不说 beautifuler？」团长笑着说：「你念十遍试试。」小北念到第三遍舌头就绕住了。团长说：「语言是懒的，怎么顺口怎么来——短词加尾巴，长词请 more 站台。」这时老团长补了一句：「还有几位连尾巴都不肯加的——good 一比就换脸成 better，最好干脆叫 best；bad 一比变 worse，最糟是 worst。它们被用得太多，脾气最大。」

cards.detail: 一两个音节的短词，比较级加 -er，最高级加 -est。

cards.rule: 尾巴的三条拼写小规则
cards.detail: 以 e 结尾只加 r/st；辅音+y 变 i 再加；短元音+单辅音先双写。

cards.rule: 长词：请 more / most 站台
cards.detail: 三个音节以上的长词加尾巴念不动——beautifuler 念不出来吧？语言是懒的，怎么顺口怎么来。

cards.rule: 比一比要有 than，最高级要有 the 和范围
cards.detail: A 比 B → A is taller than B；全班第一 → the tallest in our class（of the three / in the world）。
cards.example: A violin is smaller than a cello. / the biggest of the four

cards.rule: 换脸的不规则四大家（最常用，最不规则）
cards.example: My cold is worse today. / This is the best song.

cards.detail: 两边打平用 as + 原形 + as，形容词不用换衣服。
cards.example: Ben is as tall as Tom.（一样高）

basic.en: My schoolbag is heavier than yours.
basic.cn: 我的书包比你的重。（heavy→heavier，y 变 i）

basic.en: This road is longer than that one.
Amy is the tallest in the band.
basic.cn: 艾米是乐队里最高的。（the + est + 范围）
今天比昨天热。（hot 双写 t）

basic.en: This film is more interesting than the last one.
basic.cn: 这部电影比上一部有意思。（长词请 more）

mid.en: Maths is more difficult than music for me.
mid.cn: 对我来说数学比音乐难。（difficult 是长词）

mid.en: This is the most beautiful park in our city.
mid.cn: 这是我们城市里最美的公园。（the most + 长词）

mid.en: Your handwriting is better than mine.
mid.cn: 你的字写得比我好。（good 换脸 better）

mid.en: The weather is getting worse and worse.
Of the three brothers, Dani is the youngest.
mid.cn: 三兄弟里达尼最小。（of the three 报范围）

trap.en: This puzzle is easier than it looks.
trap.cn: 这个拼图比看上去容易。
trap.note: easy 辅音+y → easier，别写成 easyer。

trap.en: My grandpa is the oldest person in our building.
trap.cn: 我爷爷是我们楼里年纪最大的人。
trap.note: 最高级别忘了 the——tallest/oldest 光着头不能上台。

trap.en: This song is much better than that one.
trap.note: 「好得多」用 much better——不说 more better，more 和换脸不能叠加。

trap.en: I have more books than my cousin.
trap.note: many 的比较级是换脸的 more——不存在 manyer。

trap.en: Winter days are shorter than summer days.
trap.note: 比较的是「冬天的白昼」和「夏天的白昼」——两边要摆得对称。

trap.en: My kite flies as high as yours.
trap.cn: 我的风筝飞得和你的一样高。
trap.note: 「一样」用 as...as，中间是原形 high——不变形。

redBlack.bad: I'm three years old than my sister.（想说大三岁）
redBlack.good: I'm three years older than my sister.
redBlack.why: old 忘了变形，前半句成了「我三岁」——年龄整个说拧了。

redBlack.bad: Tom is the taller in our class.（想说全班最高）
redBlack.good: Tom is the tallest in our class.
redBlack.why: taller 是「两个里较高的」——想说第一名却报成了二人对比，名次全乱。

redBlack.bad: This bike is more faster than mine.
redBlack.good: This bike is faster than mine.
redBlack.why: more 和 -er 只能请一个——双重比较是贪心。

redBlack.bad: Her drawing is gooder than mine.
redBlack.good: Her drawing is better than mine.
redBlack.why: good 一比就换脸——better，没有 gooder 这张脸。

redBlack.bad: My cough is badder at night.
redBlack.good: My cough is worse at night.
redBlack.why: bad 的比较级是换脸的 worse——badder 是假脸。
辅音+y 要变 i 再加 -er——happier。

redBlack.bad: Summer is biger fun than winter.（big 比较级拼错）
redBlack.good: big→bigger：短元音+单辅音要先双写。
redBlack.why: big 双写 g 再加 -er——biger 少了一个 g。

redBlack.bad: An elephant is heavier then a horse.
redBlack.good: An elephant is heavier than a horse.
redBlack.why: 比较用 than，不是 then（那时）——一个字母，考点一个。

redBlack.bad: The Yellow River is second longest river in China.
redBlack.good: The Yellow River is the second longest river in China.
redBlack.why: 最高级（含第二、第三名）头上都要戴 the。

redBlack.bad: This is the most easy question in the paper.
redBlack.good: This is the easiest question in the paper.
redBlack.why: easy 是短词，自己长尾巴 easiest——不劳驾 most。

redBlack.bad: He is taller than I.（有人说必须用 I）
redBlack.good: taller than me / taller than I am 都可以。
redBlack.why: 口语 than me 完全通用，than I am 更正式——KET 不设这个坑。

redBlack.bad: Which is farther, the moon or the sun?（有人纠结 further）
redBlack.why: 说距离两个都通用——不挡意思，考试也不设坑。

contrast.cn: 更高、最高。（形容词不动，换前面的字）
contrast.en: taller / the tallest（形容词自己变形）
contrast.diff: 中文把「更、最」放在词前；英语让短词长尾巴、长词请 more/most。

contrast.cn: 我比他高。（「比他」在动词前）
contrast.en: I am taller than him.（than 在形容词后）
contrast.diff: 中文的「比」先出场；英语先说结论 taller，再用 than 补上对手。

contrast.cn: 他是我们班最高的。（不用报范围也行）
contrast.en: He is the tallest in our class.（the + 范围）
contrast.diff: 英语的最高级要戴 the，还习惯报出比赛范围 in/of。

contrast.cn: 这首歌更更好听。（中文没人这么说）
contrast.diff: 中文天然不会双重比较；英语孩子却常把 more 和 -er/换脸叠着用——贪心是通病。

contrast.cn: 他和我一样高。（「一样」+形容词）
contrast.en: He is as tall as me.（as...as 夹原形）
contrast.diff: 中英都不变形，但英语要用 as...as 把形容词夹在中间。

quickJudge.mnemonic: 短词长尾巴，长词请 more；比要 than，最要 the；good bad 会换脸，more 和 -er 不同台。
steps: 先认词：是 good/bad/many/little 四大家吗？是 → 直接换脸（better/worse/more/less）。
数长短：短词加 -er/-est，过一遍拼写三小规则；长词请 more/most 站台。
「比」字句检查 than 到场没有；「最」字句检查 the 和范围（in/of）到场没有。
贪心警报：more 和 -er（或换脸）绝不同台——more better、more faster 都不行。

parentScript.script: 「宝贝，咱们全家来量身高：你比我高还是矮？用英语说说看——taller 还是 shorter？记得带上 than：I am shorter than Dad. 三个人一起比，第一名就要说 the tallest——最高级是冠军，头上要戴 the 这顶皇冠。再考考你：这两幅画哪幅更好看？『更好』英语不说 gooder，good 一比赛就换脸，变成 better；『最好』是 best。我不懂英语没关系，我就当裁判听两件事：比的时候有没有 than 的音，more 和 -er 有没有贪心地一起出现。」平时逛超市也能玩：两样水果比大小、三样零食选最好——故意说 gooder、more bigger 让孩子来抓错，抓到有奖。
questions: 「更高」和「最高」英语怎么说？「最」字前面要戴什么？
「更好」为什么不是 gooder？good 换的那张脸叫什么？
more faster 错在哪？more 和 -er 能不能一起上台？

sections.echo: good→better→best、bad→worse→worst——注意到没有：英语里最常用的形容词，比较级偏偏最不规则。这不是巧合。better/best 和 good 压根不是一家人：good 是一族古词，bet-/bat-（「有利、合适」）是另一族，两族在漫长的岁月里被硬拼成一套；worse/worst 同样是外姓入赘。为什么偏偏是它们？因为「更好」「更糟」天天挂在每个人嘴边——老形态每天被念一遍，根本轮不到被 -er 规则收编；冷门词没人记得住旧形，早就乖乖加 -er 了。你已经不止一次遇见这条规律：越常用的词，越不规则。现在可以确认：这不是巧合，是英语的秩序。

questions.q: tall 的比较级是？
questions.explain: 短词长尾巴——taller。

questions.q: tall 的最高级是？
questions.explain: 短词最高级加 -est——tallest。

questions.q: beautiful 的比较级是？
questions.explain: 长词加尾巴念不动——请 more 站台。

questions.q: 为什么 beautiful 不加 -er？
options: 加了念不顺口——语言是懒的
questions.explain: beautifuler 念十遍舌头打结——怎么顺口怎么来。

questions.q: good 的比较级是？
questions.explain: good 一比就换脸——better。

questions.q: good 的最高级是？
questions.explain: best——换脸家族没有规则尾巴。

questions.q: bad 的比较级是？
questions.explain: bad 换脸成 worse。

questions.q: bad 的最高级是？
questions.explain: worst——最糟的那张脸。

questions.q: happy 的比较级怎么拼？
questions.explain: 辅音+y 变 i 再加 -er。

questions.q: big 的比较级怎么拼？
questions.explain: 短元音+单辅音先双写——bigger。

questions.q: nice 的比较级怎么拼？
questions.explain: 以 e 结尾只加 r——nicer。

questions.q: 「A 比 B 高」中间少不了哪个词？
questions.explain: 比一比要有 than——A is taller than B。

questions.q: 最高级前面要戴什么？
questions.explain: 冠军的皇冠——the tallest。

questions.q: many 的比较级是？
questions.explain: many/much 都换脸成 more。

questions.q: little（少）的比较级是？
questions.explain: little→less→least——换脸四大家之一。

questions.q: 「一样高」用哪个句式？
questions.explain: 打平用 as + 原形 + as，不变形。

questions.q: A cello is ___ than a violin.
questions.explain: big 双写 g——bigger than。

questions.q: This maths problem is ___ than that one.
questions.explain: difficult 是长词——more difficult。

questions.q: Amy is ___ girl in our band.
questions.explain: 全团第一——the tallest。

questions.q: My handwriting is ___ than last term. The teacher smiled!
questions.explain: good 换脸——better。

questions.q: The weather today is ___ than yesterday — take your raincoat.
questions.explain: bad 换脸——worse。

questions.q: This is ___ story in the whole book.
questions.explain: 长词最高级——the most interesting。

questions.q: A rabbit is ___ than a tortoise.
questions.explain: 短词——faster than。

questions.q: I feel ___ today than yesterday. The medicine works!
questions.explain: y 变 i——happier。

questions.q: Winter is ___ season of the year in Harbin.
questions.explain: 四季里的第一名——the coldest + of the year。

questions.q: I have ___ stickers than my deskmate.
questions.explain: many 换脸 more——more stickers than。

questions.q: This bottle holds ___ water than that one.（更少）
questions.explain: little 换脸 less——less water。

questions.q: Your idea is much ___ than mine. Let's use it!
questions.explain: 「好得多」much better——more 不能再叠上去。

questions.q: My scarf is as ___ as yours.
questions.explain: as...as 中间站原形——as long as。

questions.q: The Yangtze River is ___ river in China.
questions.explain: 中国范围内的第一——the longest。

questions.q: This song sounds ___ than it looks on paper.
questions.explain: e 结尾只加 r——nicer。

questions.q: Of the four seasons, I like autumn ___.
questions.explain: 四个里选最爱——like...best。

questions.q: 哪句没犯贪心病？
options: This train is faster than the bus.
This train is more faster than the bus.
This train is more fast than the bus.
questions.explain: more 和 -er 只能请一个——faster。

questions.q: 哪句的脸换对了？
options: Her cake tastes better than mine.
Her cake tastes gooder than mine.
Her cake tastes more good than mine.
questions.explain: good→better，没有 gooder。

questions.q: 哪句拼对了尾巴？
options: The sun is hotter in July.
The sun is hoter in July.
The sun is more hot in July.
questions.explain: hot 双写 t——hotter。

questions.q: 哪句的 than 写对了？
options: A whale is heavier than an elephant.
A whale is heavier then an elephant.
A whale is heavier as an elephant.
questions.explain: 比较用 than——then 是「那时」。

questions.q: 哪句的皇冠戴上了？
options: Mount Qomolangma is the highest mountain in the world.
Mount Qomolangma is highest mountain in the world.
Mount Qomolangma is the higher mountain in the world.
questions.explain: 世界第一——the highest。

questions.q: 哪句给短词选对了路？
options: This is the easiest way home.
This is the most easy way home.
This is the easyest way home.
questions.explain: easy 短词自己变——easiest（y 变 i）。

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（我的感冒更糟了）
options: My cold is worse than last night.
My cold is badder than last night.
My cold is more worse than last night.
questions.explain: worse 已是换好的脸——不加 more 不加 -er。

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（弟弟比我小两岁）
options: My brother is two years younger than me.
My brother is two years young than me.
My brother is two years the youngest than me.
questions.explain: 「小两岁」＝数字 + younger than。

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（这是三条围巾里最便宜的）
options: This is the cheapest of the three scarves.
This is the cheaper of the three scarves.
This is cheapest in the three scarves.
questions.explain: 三选一的第一名——the cheapest of the three。

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（她和姐姐一样细心）
options: She is as careful as her sister.
She is as more careful as her sister.
She is careful than her sister the same.
questions.explain: as + 原形 + as——打平不变形。

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（我的作业错误更少）
options: My homework has fewer mistakes than before.
My homework has less mistakes than before.
My homework has fewer mistake than before.
questions.explain: mistakes 数得清——用 fewer；数不清的才用 less。

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（这个故事更有趣了）
options: The story gets more interesting in chapter two.
The story gets interestinger in chapter two.
The story gets the most interesting in chapter two.（想说更有趣）
questions.explain: 长词比较级——more interesting；「更」不是「最」。

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（今天的雨比早上大）
options: The rain is heavier than it was this morning.
The rain is heavyer than it was this morning.
The rain is more heavy than it was this morning.
questions.explain: heavy y 变 i——heavier。

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（他是两人里跑得较快的那个——两人对比）
options: He is the faster of the two runners.
He is the fastest of the two runners.
He is faster of two runner.
questions.explain: 两人对比用比较级 the faster of the two——「最」要三个起步。

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（这是我听过最好的演出）
options: It's the best concert I have ever heard.
It's the goodest concert I have ever heard.
It's the better concert I have ever heard.
questions.explain: 最高级换脸——the best。

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（问班里谁最高）
options: Who is the tallest in your class?
Who is taller in your class?
Who is the most tall in your class?
questions.explain: 全班范围的第一名——the tallest in。

questions.q: Ben is tall. Tom is ___ than Ben. Amy is ___ of the three.
questions.explain: 两人比用 -er；三人排名用 the -est。

questions.q: This piano piece is hard, that one is ___, and the last one is ___ in the book.
questions.explain: hard→harder→the hardest，皇冠别丢。

questions.q: — Which do you like ___, spring or autumn? — Autumn, because the air is ___.
questions.explain: 二选一用 better；说理由用 cooler。

questions.q: My old bike was slow. My new one is much ___, but Dad's is still ___ in our family.
questions.explain: much faster 强调差距；家里第一 the fastest。

questions.q: Lily sings ___ than me, but she says my drawing is ___ than hers.
questions.explain: 两处都是 good/well 换脸——better。

questions.q: The film was ___ than the book — in fact it was ___ film of the year.
questions.explain: 长词全程请 more/most，最高级戴 the。

questions.q: My cold got ___ yesterday, but today it is a little ___.
questions.explain: 先坏后好——worse 和 better 两张换好的脸。

questions.q: A mouse is small, a beetle is ___, and an ant is ___ of the three.
questions.explain: smaller → the smallest，of the three 报范围。

questions.q: I spent ___ time on maths than on English this week, so my English got ___ marks.
questions.explain: more time（much 换脸）+ better marks（good 换脸）。

questions.q: This street is as ___ as that one, but it has ___ cars, so it feels quieter.
questions.explain: as wide as 打平不变形；cars 数得清用 fewer。

questions.q: Today is the ___ day of the year — even ___ than last Sunday!
questions.explain: hot 双写 t：hottest / hotter。

questions.q: Of all the subjects, I think music is ___, and maths is ___ for me.
options: the most interesting / the most difficult
questions.explain: 「所有科目里」是排名——两个长词都用 the most。

questions.q: My answer had ___ mistakes than yours — only two, the ___ in the class!
questions.explain: mistakes 可数：fewer → the fewest。

questions.q: The blue whale is ___ animal on Earth — even ___ than the biggest dinosaur.
questions.explain: 地球第一 the largest；跟恐龙单挑用 larger。

questions.q: — Was the test hard? — The last question was ___ one, but it was still ___ than I feared.
questions.explain: 卷子里的第一难 the hardest；比想象容易 easier。

questions.q: 大考：Our band played ___ than last year, made ___ mistakes, and won ___ prize of the night.
questions.explain: better（换脸）+ fewer mistakes（可数）+ the biggest prize（最高级戴 the）——三关一次过。

detective.sentence: My new schoolbag is more bigger than the old one.
detective.fixed: My new schoolbag is bigger than the old one.
detective.clue: more 和 -er 是贪心双重比较——big 自己会长尾巴。

detective.sentence: This is the goodest ice cream in our town.
detective.fixed: This is the best ice cream in our town.
detective.clue: good 的最高级是换脸的 best——goodest 是假脸。

detective.sentence: Today's weather is badder than yesterday's.
detective.fixed: Today's weather is worse than yesterday's.
detective.clue: bad 一比就换脸——worse，不长 -er 尾巴。

detective.sentence: A plane is much faster then a train.
detective.fixed: A plane is much faster than a train.
detective.clue: 比较用 than——then 是「那时」，一个字母之差。

detective.sentence: Dani is tallest player in the basketball team.
detective.fixed: Dani is the tallest player in the basketball team.
detective.clue: 最高级是冠军，头上要戴 the 这顶皇冠。

detective.sentence: The maths test was easyer than I thought.
detective.fixed: The maths test was easier than I thought.
detective.clue: 辅音+y 变 i 再加 -er——easier。

detective.sentence: I think spring is the most nice season of all.
detective.fixed: I think spring is the nicest season of all.
detective.clue: nice 是短词，自己长尾巴 nicest——不劳驾 most。
